test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: The "Lahore Resolution" passed by the Muslim League in 1940 demanded:

options.text: Complete integration of all princely states with British India.
The creation of a separate state for Muslims in the northwestern and eastern parts of India.
Equal representation for Muslims in all legislative bodies
The continuation of a united India with enhanced safeguards eguards for minority rights.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The creation of a separate state for Muslims in the northwestern and eastern parts of India.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Lahore Resolution**, also known as the **Pakistan Resolution**, was formally adopted by the **All-India Muslim League** during its general session held from **March 22 to March 24, 1940**, at **Minto Park** in Lahore.
 
• The resolution was moved by **A.K. Fazlul Huq**, the then Premier of **Bengal**, and seconded by various leaders from different provinces, signifying a unified demand for Muslim political autonomy.
 
• It explicitly demanded that **geographically contiguous units** in the **North-Western** and **Eastern zones** of India, where Muslims were in a numerical majority, should be grouped to constitute **Independent States**.
 
• The resolution rejected the **Government of India Act 1935** and the concept of a **United India**, arguing that the communal situation required a solution based on the **Two-Nation Theory**.
 
• This document marked a definitive shift in the **Muslim League’s** policy, moving away from seeking constitutional safeguards for a minority to demanding **sovereign statehood** for a nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Two-Nation Theory**:
 
 
• Propounded primarily by **Muhammad Ali Jinnah**, it argued that Hindus and Muslims were two distinct nations with separate cultures, laws, and social moralities.
 
• This theory formed the ideological backbone of the demand for the partition of **British India** in **1947**.
 
 
 
• **Choudhry Rahmat Ali**:
 
 
• A student at **Cambridge University** who coined the term **'Pakistan'** in his **1933** pamphlet titled **'Now or Never'**.
 
• The name was an acronym representing **Punjab**, **Afghania** (North-West Frontier Province), **Kashmir**, **Sindh**, and **Balochistan**.
 
 
 
• **Minar-e-Pakistan**:
 
 
• A **monument** built in Lahore between **1960 and 1968** at the exact site where the resolution was passed to commemorate the historic event.
